---- MODULE W4Od0m4p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Surgery, Slot, MaxQ, NoSurg, NoRoom

ASSUME NoSurg \notin Surgery /\ NoRoom \notin Slot

VARIABLES queue, assign, roomOf, open, done
vars == <<queue, assign, roomOf, open, done>>

InQueue(s) == \E i \in 1..Len(queue) : queue[i] = s
Assigned(s) == \E r \in Slot : assign[r] = s

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ assign = [r \in Slot |-> NoSurg]
  /\ roomOf = [s \in Surgery |-> NoRoom]
  /\ open = Slot
  /\ done = {}

Arrive(s) ==
  /\ s \notin done
  /\ ~InQueue(s)
  /\ ~Assigned(s)
  /\ Len(queue) < MaxQ
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, s)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<assign, roomOf, open, done>>

Assign(r) ==
  /\ r \in open
  /\ assign[r] = NoSurg
  /\ queue # << >>
  /\ LET s == Head(queue) IN
       /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![r] = s]
       /\ roomOf' = [roomOf EXCEPT ![s] = r]
       /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<open, done>>

Complete(r) ==
  /\ assign[r] # NoSurg
  /\ LET s == assign[r] IN
       /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![r] = NoSurg]
       /\ roomOf' = [roomOf EXCEPT ![s] = NoRoom]
       /\ done' = done \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, open>>

OpenRoom(r) ==
  /\ r \notin open
  /\ open' = open \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, assign, roomOf, done>>

CloseRoom(r) ==
  /\ r \in open
  /\ assign[r] = NoSurg
  /\ open' = open \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, assign, roomOf, done>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Surgery : Arrive(s)
  \/ \E r \in Slot : Assign(r)
  \/ \E r \in Slot : Complete(r)
  \/ \E r \in Slot : OpenRoom(r)
  \/ \E r \in Slot : CloseRoom(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AssignmentConsistent ==
  /\ \A r \in Slot : assign[r] # NoSurg => roomOf[assign[r]] = r
  /\ \A s \in Surgery : roomOf[s] # NoRoom => assign[roomOf[s]] = s
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Surgery = {x1, x2, x3}
  Slot = {o1, o2}
  MaxQ = 2
  NoSurg = NoSurg
  NoRoom = NoRoom
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AssignmentConsistent
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler admits surgery requests and places them into open operating rooms. Incoming surgery requests wait in a bounded intake queue; when the queue is already at its capacity, a new request is refused (backpressure) rather than dropped silently elsewhere. A scheduler takes the request at the head of the queue and assigns it to some room that is currently open and empty, recording both that the room now holds that surgery and that the surgery is located in that room. When a surgery finishes, its room is emptied and the surgery is marked done. The hospital may reconfigure its capacity at runtime: a closed room can be opened, and an open room can be closed only while it is empty. The system tracks, for every room, which surgery (if any) occupies it, and for every surgery, which room (if any) it is in; these two views must never disagree. In particular a surgery can occupy at most one room and a room's recorded occupant must agree with that surgery's recorded room.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The room-to-surgery assignment and the surgery-to-room location are mutual inverses on all active placements, so no surgery is ever allocated to two different rooms and no room's occupant record contradicts the surgery's own room record.

---- MODULE W4Od12m4p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Staff, MaxEpoch, MaxCap

VARIABLES epoch, authorized, queue, cap, committed
vars == <<epoch, authorized, queue, cap, committed>>

InQueue(s) == \E i \in 1..Len(queue) : queue[i] = s

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ authorized = {}
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ cap = 2
  /\ committed = {}

Grant(s) ==
  /\ s \notin authorized
  /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, queue, cap, committed>>

Enqueue(s) ==
  /\ s \in authorized
  /\ ~InQueue(s)
  /\ Len(queue) < cap
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, s)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, authorized, cap, committed>>

Process ==
  /\ queue # << >>
  /\ Head(queue) \in authorized
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {Head(queue)}
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, authorized, cap>>

Rotate ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ authorized' = {}
  /\ queue' = << >>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, committed>>

Resize(n) ==
  /\ n \in 1..MaxCap
  /\ n >= Len(queue)
  /\ cap' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, authorized, queue, committed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Staff : Grant(s)
  \/ \E s \in Staff : Enqueue(s)
  \/ Process
  \/ Rotate
  \/ \E n \in 1..MaxCap : Resize(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BackpressuredAuthorized ==
  /\ Len(queue) <= cap
  /\ \A i \in 1..Len(queue) : queue[i] \in authorized
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Staff = {p1, p2, p3}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BackpressuredAuthorized
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker serves withdrawal requests filed by staff members through a bounded intake queue. A staff member may only act while holding a current authorization token: the bank issues a token by granting authorization at the present epoch. When the bank reconfigures (an epoch rotation, which also lets it resize its intake capacity), every previously issued token becomes stale, and any requests still waiting in the queue are purged, because they can no longer be trusted. Only currently authorized staff may enqueue a withdrawal request, and the queue has a capacity limit: when it is full, further requests are refused (backpressure) rather than admitted. A background processor takes the request at the head of the queue and commits it, but only for staff that are still authorized. The bank may change its queue capacity at runtime, but never below the number of requests already waiting.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At all times the intake queue holds no more requests than the current capacity, and every request waiting in the queue belongs to a currently authorized staff member, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever occupies the queue.

---- MODULE W4Od2m5p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robot, Controller, Cap, Quorum, Instance

VARIABLES vote, grantedBy, pending, done
vars == <<vote, grantedBy, pending, done>>

Active == UNION { grantedBy[i] : i \in Instance }

Init ==
  /\ vote = [rb \in Robot |-> {}]
  /\ grantedBy = [i \in Instance |-> {}]
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ done = {}

Request(rb) ==
  /\ rb \notin pending
  /\ rb \notin Active
  /\ rb \notin done
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {rb}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, grantedBy, done>>

CastVote(rb, c) ==
  /\ rb \in pending
  /\ c \notin vote[rb]
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![rb] = @ \cup {c}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grantedBy, pending, done>>

Grant(rb, i) ==
  /\ rb \in pending
  /\ Cardinality(vote[rb]) >= Quorum
  /\ Cardinality(Active) < Cap
  /\ grantedBy' = [grantedBy EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {rb}]
  /\ pending' = pending \ {rb}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, done>>

Release(rb, i) ==
  /\ rb \in grantedBy[i]
  /\ grantedBy' = [grantedBy EXCEPT ![i] = @ \ {rb}]
  /\ done' = done \cup {rb}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, pending>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ Idle
  \/ \E rb \in Robot : Request(rb)
  \/ \E rb \in Robot, c \in Controller : CastVote(rb, c)
  \/ \E rb \in Robot, i \in Instance : Grant(rb, i)
  \/ \E rb \in Robot, i \in Instance : Release(rb, i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PoolCapacity ==
  /\ \A i, j \in Instance : i # j => grantedBy[i] \cap grantedBy[j] = {}
  /\ Cardinality(Active) <= Cap
  /\ \A rb \in Active : Cardinality(vote[rb]) >= Quorum
====
nl:
A warehouse operates a fleet of charging bays as a single shared pool, dispatched by two independent controller instances (call them a and b) that draw from that same pool. Before any robot may occupy a charging bay, its request must gather quorum approval: a majority of the supervising controllers must each cast a vote for that request. A robot first files a request, then controllers vote on it one at a time. Once a request has collected a quorum of votes, either dispatcher instance may grant it a bay, provided the shared pool has not reached its capacity; the grant is booked against whichever instance issued it. When a robot finishes charging it releases its bay back to the pool. Because both instances share one pool, the total number of bays held across both instances together must respect the single pool capacity, and no robot may be simultaneously granted by both instances.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The bays granted by the two instances are always disjoint and their union never exceeds the pool capacity, and every granted robot had gathered at least a quorum of votes.

---- MODULE W4Od6m7p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Car, Slot, NoSlot, MaxVer

ASSUME NoSlot \notin Slot

VARIABLES alloc, ver, rdVer, target
vars == <<alloc, ver, rdVer, target>>

OwnedBy(s) == { c \in Car : <<s, c>> \in alloc }

Init ==
  /\ alloc = {}
  /\ ver = [s \in Slot |-> 0]
  /\ rdVer = [c \in Car |-> 0]
  /\ target = [c \in Car |-> NoSlot]

Read(c, s) ==
  /\ target[c] = NoSlot
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![c] = s]
  /\ rdVer' = [rdVer EXCEPT ![c] = ver[s]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, ver>>

Claim(c) ==
  /\ target[c] # NoSlot
  /\ LET s == target[c] IN
       /\ rdVer[c] = ver[s]
       /\ ver[s] < MaxVer
       /\ OwnedBy(s) = {}
       /\ alloc' = alloc \cup {<<s, c>>}
       /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![c] = NoSlot]
  /\ UNCHANGED rdVer

StaleAbort(c) ==
  /\ target[c] # NoSlot
  /\ rdVer[c] # ver[target[c]]
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![c] = NoSlot]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, ver, rdVer>>

Release(c, s) ==
  /\ <<s, c>> \in alloc
  /\ ver[s] < MaxVer
  /\ alloc' = alloc \ {<<s, c>>}
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<rdVer, target>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ Idle
  \/ \E c \in Car, s \in Slot : Read(c, s)
  \/ \E c \in Car : Claim(c)
  \/ \E c \in Car : StaleAbort(c)
  \/ \E c \in Car, s \in Slot : Release(c, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtMostOneOwnerPerSlot ==
  \A s \in Slot : \A c1, c2 \in Car :
     (<<s, c1>> \in alloc /\ <<s, c2>> \in alloc) => c1 = c2
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Car = {k1, k2}
  Slot = {f1, f2}
  NoSlot = NoSlot
  MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AtMostOneOwnerPerSlot
nl:
An elevator bank assigns hall-call slots (one per floor button) to individual cars using a compare-and-swap discipline. Each slot carries a version counter. A car that wants a slot first reads the slot, remembering the version it saw; a slow car may hold an old (stale) reading for a while but it never fails outright. To take the slot the car performs a compare-and-swap: the claim succeeds only if the slot's current version still equals the version the car read, and only if the slot is currently unowned; on success the car is recorded as the slot's owner and the version is bumped. If the car's remembered version is stale (no longer current) the compare-and-swap aborts harmlessly and the car drops its attempt. A car may later release a slot it owns, again bumping the version. Because a claim can only land against the version it read, two cars can never both be recorded as owners of the very same slot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every hall-call slot there is at most one car recorded as its owner at any time, so the same slot is never allocated to two different cars.

---- MODULE W4Od6m5p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Writer, Voter, Quorum, MaxV, None

VARIABLES version, log, votes, base
vars == <<version, log, votes, base>>

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ log = [v \in 0..MaxV |-> None]
  /\ votes = [w \in Writer |-> {}]
  /\ base = [w \in Writer |-> -1]

ReadRec(w) ==
  /\ base[w] = -1
  /\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![w] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, log, votes>>

Vote(w, v) ==
  /\ base[w] # -1
  /\ v \notin votes[w]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![w] = @ \cup {v}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, log, base>>

Commit(w) ==
  /\ base[w] # -1
  /\ base[w] = version
  /\ version < MaxV
  /\ Cardinality(votes[w]) >= Quorum
  /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![version] = <<w, base[w]>>]
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![w] = -1]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![w] = {}]

Abandon(w) ==
  /\ base[w] # -1
  /\ base[w] # version
  /\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![w] = -1]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![w] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, log>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ Idle
  \/ \E w \in Writer : ReadRec(w)
  \/ \E w \in Writer, v \in Voter : Vote(w, v)
  \/ \E w \in Writer : Commit(w)
  \/ \E w \in Writer : Abandon(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
  /\ \A v \in 0..MaxV : (log[v] # None) <=> (v < version)
  /\ \A v \in 0..MaxV : log[v] # None => log[v][2] = v
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Writer = {w1, w2}
  Voter = {v1, v2, v3}
  Quorum = 2
  MaxV = 3
  None = None
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
Two independent elevator-dispatch instances share a single occupancy record for the building, and both may write to it. The record carries a version number that counts how many committed updates it has absorbed. To change the record, an instance first reads the current version (opening a proposal stamped with the version it saw), then gathers quorum approval: a majority of the supervising voters must approve the proposal. The instance may then commit its update, but only if the version it originally read is still the current version and it has quorum; committing records, at the slot indexed by that version, both which writer committed and the base version the write was built on, and advances the version by one. If, by the time an instance is ready, the version it read is no longer current, its proposal is stale and must be abandoned rather than applied, so that it cannot clobber an update it never saw. This is exactly what prevents a lost update: no write built on an out-of-date view is ever allowed to overwrite the record.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every committed update is stored contiguously below the current version, and each stored update's recorded base version equals its own slot index, so no update built on a stale version was ever applied and no update was lost by being overwritten.

---- MODULE W4Od1m7p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Flight, Runway, Total, NoFlight

ASSUME NoFlight \notin Flight

VARIABLES reg, free, reqs, served
vars == <<reg, free, reqs, served>>

Occupied == { r \in Runway : reg[r] # NoFlight }

Init ==
  /\ reg = [r \in Runway |-> NoFlight]
  /\ free = Total
  /\ reqs = {}
  /\ served = {}

SendRequest(f, r) ==
  /\ f \notin served
  /\ <<f, r>> \notin reqs
  /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {<<f, r>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, free, served>>

Allocate(f, r) ==
  /\ <<f, r>> \in reqs
  /\ reg[r] = NoFlight
  /\ free > 0
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![r] = f]
  /\ free' = free - 1
  /\ reqs' = reqs \ {<<f, r>>}
  /\ served' = served \cup {f}

RejectOccupied(f, r) ==
  /\ <<f, r>> \in reqs
  /\ reg[r] # NoFlight
  /\ reqs' = reqs \ {<<f, r>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, free, served>>

Release(r) ==
  /\ reg[r] # NoFlight
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![r] = NoFlight]
  /\ free' = free + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reqs, served>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ Idle
  \/ \E f \in Flight, r \in Runway : SendRequest(f, r)
  \/ \E f \in Flight, r \in Runway : Allocate(f, r)
  \/ \E f \in Flight, r \in Runway : RejectOccupied(f, r)
  \/ \E r \in Runway : Release(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TokenConservation == free + Cardinality(Occupied) = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Flight = {a1, a2, a3}
  Runway = {rw1, rw2}
  Total = 2
  NoFlight = NoFlight
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TokenConservation
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator manages a fixed pool of runway clearance tokens; the total number of tokens is a conserved quantity, so a token is only ever moved between the free pool and a runway, never created or destroyed. Controllers send allocation request messages naming a flight and a runway; these messages travel over an unordered channel and may be processed in any order relative to one another. Each runway holds a compare-and-swap register recording its current flight, or nothing. To honor a request the allocator performs a compare-and-swap: if the named runway's register is currently empty it stamps the flight into it and takes one token from the free pool; if the runway is already occupied the request is simply discarded. When a flight departs, its runway register is cleared and the token is returned to the free pool. At every instant the number of free tokens plus the number of occupied runways equals the fixed total, because each allocation moves exactly one token out of the pool and each release moves exactly one back.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The count of free clearance tokens plus the count of currently occupied runways always equals the fixed total number of tokens, so no clearance token is ever created or destroyed.

---- MODULE W4Od17m9p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Router, Belt, MaxEpoch, NoBelt

ASSUME NoBelt \notin Belt

VARIABLES heldBelt, grantEpoch, epoch
vars == <<heldBelt, grantEpoch, epoch>>

Init ==
  /\ heldBelt = [r \in Router |-> NoBelt]
  /\ grantEpoch = [r \in Router |-> 0]
  /\ epoch = 0

Acquire(r, b) ==
  /\ heldBelt[r] = NoBelt
  /\ \A other \in Router : heldBelt[other] # b
  /\ heldBelt' = [heldBelt EXCEPT ![r] = b]
  /\ grantEpoch' = [grantEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Renew(r) ==
  /\ heldBelt[r] # NoBelt
  /\ grantEpoch' = [grantEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<heldBelt, epoch>>

Release(r) ==
  /\ heldBelt[r] # NoBelt
  /\ heldBelt' = [heldBelt EXCEPT ![r] = NoBelt]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grantEpoch, epoch>>

Evict(r) ==
  /\ heldBelt[r] # NoBelt
  /\ grantEpoch[r] < epoch
  /\ heldBelt' = [heldBelt EXCEPT ![r] = NoBelt]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grantEpoch, epoch>>

Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<heldBelt, grantEpoch>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ Idle
  \/ \E r \in Router, b \in Belt : Acquire(r, b)
  \/ \E r \in Router : Renew(r)
  \/ \E r \in Router : Release(r)
  \/ \E r \in Router : Evict(r)
  \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BeltMutualExclusion ==
  \A r1, r2 \in Router :
     (r1 # r2 /\ heldBelt[r1] # NoBelt /\ heldBelt[r2] # NoBelt)
        => heldBelt[r1] # heldBelt[r2]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Router = {i1, i2}
  Belt = {b1, b2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  NoBelt = NoBelt
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BeltMutualExclusion
nl:
An airport baggage router runs two independent router instances that share one pool of sorter belts. Each belt is a critical resource that may be held by at most one router instance at a time. The system carries a configuration epoch number. A router acquires a free belt only when no other router currently holds it, and it stamps its hold with the current epoch. When the system reconfigures, it advances the epoch; any hold stamped with an older epoch is now stale. A router may renew its hold to the current epoch, or the system may evict a router whose hold is stale, freeing the belt back to the pool. A router may also voluntarily release a belt it holds. Because acquisition requires the belt to be unheld and eviction frees stale holds, the same belt is never simultaneously held by two different router instances.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every instant no belt in the shared pool is held by two different router instances at once, preserving mutually exclusive access to each belt.

---- MODULE W4Od19m2p0t0 ----
EXTENDS FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Patron, Branch, NoPatron

ASSUME NoPatron \notin Patron

VARIABLES vote, decided, crashed, holder
vars == <<vote, decided, crashed, holder>>

Init ==
  /\ vote = [p \in Patron |-> [b \in Branch |-> "none"]]
  /\ decided = [p \in Patron |-> "undecided"]
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ holder = NoPatron

Prepare(p, b) ==
  /\ b \notin crashed
  /\ decided[p] = "undecided"
  /\ vote[p][b] = "none"
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![p][b] = "yes"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<decided, crashed, holder>>

Crash(b) ==
  /\ b \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, decided, holder>>

CommitP(p) ==
  /\ decided[p] = "undecided"
  /\ \A b \in Branch \ crashed : vote[p][b] = "yes"
  /\ holder = NoPatron
  /\ decided' = [decided EXCEPT ![p] = "commit"]
  /\ holder' = p
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed>>

AbortP(p) ==
  /\ decided[p] = "undecided"
  /\ decided' = [decided EXCEPT ![p] = "abort"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, holder>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ Idle
  \/ \E p \in Patron, b \in Branch : Prepare(p, b)
  \/ \E b \in Branch : Crash(b)
  \/ \E p \in Patron : CommitP(p)
  \/ \E p \in Patron : AbortP(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BookMutualExclusion ==
  /\ \A p1, p2 \in Patron :
        (decided[p1] = "commit" /\ decided[p2] = "commit") => p1 = p2
  /\ \A p \in Patron : decided[p] = "commit" => holder = p
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Patron = {t1, t2}
  Branch = {br1, br2}
  NoPatron = NoPatron
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BookMutualExclusion
nl:
A library book reservation system decides, by two-phase commit across its branch participants, whether to grant a single shared copy of a book to a patron. Two patrons compete for the one copy, which is a critical resource that at most one patron may hold. Each branch may vote to prepare (yes) for a given patron. A branch can crash silently at any time; once crashed it stops voting. The coordinator commits a patron's reservation only if every branch that has not crashed has voted yes for that patron, and only if no other patron currently holds the copy; committing marks that patron as the holder. The coordinator may abort a patron's reservation at any time before it commits. Because the commit rule requires that no other patron already holds the copy, the two competing reservations can never both commit.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one patron is ever in the committed state holding the book copy, and any committed patron is recorded as the current holder, so the single copy is never granted to two patrons at once.

---- MODULE W4Od5m6p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Player, Lobby, Cap, Dur, MaxTime, NoLobby

ASSUME NoLobby \notin Lobby

VARIABLES clock, seat, leaseEnd, crashed
vars == <<clock, seat, leaseEnd, crashed>>

Seated(L) == { p \in Player : seat[p] = L }

Init ==
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ seat = [p \in Player |-> NoLobby]
  /\ leaseEnd = [p \in Player |-> 0]
  /\ crashed = {}

Acquire(p, L) ==
  /\ seat[p] = NoLobby
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(Seated(L)) < Cap
  /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![p] = L]
  /\ leaseEnd' = [leaseEnd EXCEPT ![p] = clock + Dur]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, crashed>>

Renew(p) ==
  /\ seat[p] # NoLobby
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ leaseEnd' = [leaseEnd EXCEPT ![p] = clock + Dur]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, seat, crashed>>

Expire(p) ==
  /\ seat[p] # NoLobby
  /\ clock >= leaseEnd[p]
  /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![p] = NoLobby]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseEnd, crashed>>

Crash(p) ==
  /\ p \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, seat, leaseEnd>>

Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxTime
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<seat, leaseEnd, crashed>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ Idle
  \/ \E p \in Player, L \in Lobby : Acquire(p, L)

  /\ plog = << >>

  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ view = [o \in Operator |-> 0]

  /\ <<o, j>> \notin pending
  /\ <<o, j>> \notin done

  /\ UNCHANGED <<plog, done, epoch, view>>

  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, plog, done, view>>

Sync(o) ==

  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![o] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, plog, done, epoch>>

Commit(o, j) ==
  /\ <<o, j>> \in pending
  /\ view[o] = epoch
  /\ <<o, j>> \notin done

  /\ done' = done \cup {<<o, j>>}
  /\ pending' = pending \ {<<o, j>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, view>>

  \/ \E o \in Operator, j \in PrintJob : Queue(o, j)
  \/ Advance
  \/ \E o \in Operator : Sync(o)
  \/ \E o \in Operator, j \in PrintJob : Commit(o, j)

The spooler advances the epoch when it reconfigures a new round. Each operator tracks the epoch it currently sees; a slow operator may lag behind the spooler's epoch but never fails, and it eventually syncs its view forward one step at a time. Committing a job to print is an irreversible action that appends the job to a permanent, append-only completion log. Because committing is guarded against repeats, the same job can never be committed to print more than once, and the completion log never records a duplicate.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The append-only completion log never records the same job twice, so each irreversible print commitment happens at most once.

  /\ vote = [r \in RM |-> "none"]
  /\ pending = NoMove
  /\ cap = [z \in Zone |-> Total]

  /\ s # d
  /\ pending' = <<s, d>>
  /\ vote' = [r \in RM |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bags, cap>>

Prepare(r) ==
  /\ pending # NoMove
  /\ vote[r] = "none"
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![r] = "yes"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bags, pending, cap>>

  /\ \A r \in RM : vote[r] = "yes"
  /\ LET s == pending[1]
         d == pending[2] IN
       /\ bags[s] > 0
       /\ bags[d] < cap[d]
       /\ bags' = [bags EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1, ![d] = @ + 1]
  /\ pending' = NoMove
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, cap>>

Abort ==
  /\ pending # NoMove
  /\ pending' = NoMove
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bags, vote, cap>>

Resize(z, n) ==

  /\ n >= bags[z]
  /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![z] = n]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bags, vote, pending>>

  \/ \E s, d \in Zone : Propose(s, d)

  \/ Abort

Because every committed transfer moves one bag out of the source and one into the destination, the total bag count across all zones never changes.

  MaxV = 3

A library book reservation record is guarded by optimistic locking. The record carries a version number. A patron may reserve the book only while authorized; the librarian grants authorization to a patron. To reserve, a patron first reads the current version, then optimistically attempts to commit: the commit succeeds only if the patron is currently authorized and the version it read still matches the record's version, at which point the patron becomes the current holder and the version is bumped. If the version the patron read is no longer current, the attempt is stale and the patron must re-read and retry rather than force its change through. A privileged administrator may override the record directly, setting themselves as holder and bumping the version, bypassing the optimistic check. Consequently, the record's holder is always either a currently authorized patron or a privileged administrator; a stale or unauthorized patron can never become the holder.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every instant the reservation record's holder is either a currently authorized patron or a privileged administrator, so no unauthorized or stale patron is ever recorded as the holder.
